title: eludite.workspace.search input
description: Search the Workspace window as its box "Search Workspace (Ctrl+;)" does (brief 0061): `query` is typed into the box and the tree shows the rows whose name contains it (case-insensitive; every word of a multi-word query must match) with their ancestors, expanded. An empty `query` clears the box and restores the tree and its expanded set from before the search. Without `query` the box keeps its text and the answer is for that text. `focus` puts the keyboard focus in the box and shows the Workspace window (Ctrl+;).

query.description: The text to search for; empty clears the search.

focus.description: Focus the search box (and show the Workspace window), as Ctrl+; does. Default false.
